essence: The goddess is a constant source of sustenance, liberation, and prosperity.
A mantra beginning with the śrī bīja brings about an increase in happiness.
A mantra beginning with the śrī and māyā bījas grants prosperity and fulfills all wealth.
This mantra is associated with the paṅkti meter and the goddess Annapūrṇikā.
In the ritual, the initial seed of the mantra determines the assignment of its limbs.
